title: Waymo pulls its self-driving cars off highways after California ban! 🚗
body: Waymo pulls its self-driving cars off highways after California ban! 🚗

Waymo, owned by Alphabet, Google's parent company, has halted its driverless taxi service on highways across all US states, after California's Department of Motor Vehicles — the authority responsible for road safety — banned it, calling it an "imminent danger to public safety".

Two incidents were behind the move: on November 5, three Waymo cars entered an active construction zone, and on November 6 a video spread of a Waymo car overtaking two police cars that were slowing traffic. A self-driving taxi is a car that operates without a driver.

The ban has been in effect since November 11, and the halt covers Phoenix, Austin, and Miami as well as California. The service inside cities continues in 15 metro areas, and highway testing continues, but with a trained specialist behind the wheel.
Would you ride in a driverless car on a highway? 🛣️
